summary: Sun Communities Inc., through its operating partnership SCOLP and two subsidiaries (Sellers), entered into a Purchase Agreement to sell all equity of Park Holidays, its entire UK business, to Panther Bidco Limited, an affiliate of Aermont Capital LLP. The enterprise value is £768 million (~$1.03 billion), payable in cash subject to customary adjustments. Closing expected in H2 2026, conditioned on UK Financial Conduct Authority approval. No board recommendation or advisors named. The seller will be subject to two-year non-compete/non-solicit in the UK. Watch for regulatory clearance timeline; risk-arb centers on FCA approval and potential pre-emptive bids.
